title: DC-area forecast: Scattered showers tonight, mostly dry but hot on Thursday
subtitle: HAPPENING NOW: Evening temperatures fall back into the 70s a little after sunset. Scattered showers are possible between 8 p.m. and midnight. Lows range from the upper 60s to low 70s.
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Evening temperatures fall back into the 70s a little after sunset. Scattered showers or even a thunderstorm are possible between 8 p.m. and midnight. Lows range from the upper 60s to low 70s.

What’s next? Maybe a touch warmer tomorrow, with little chance of rain. The Friday forecast is tricky but Saturday looks quite nice!

Forecast in detail

Tonight: Partly cloudy with showers or a thunderstorm possible, mainly between 8 p.m. and midnight. Lows in the upper 60s to low 70s. Confidence: Medium

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Thursday): A touch warmer but much the same as today. Skies should be partly sunny again with highs in the upper 80s to low 90s and moderate to high humidity (dew points near 70). Again just the chance of an isolated shower or storm. Confidence: Medium-High

Tomorrow night: Isolated to scattered showers and storms are possible at some point during the evening or overnight. Otherwise it's partly to mostly cloudy and rather muggy with lows near 70 to the low 70s. Confidence: Medium

📬 Get our forecast in your inbox

Our morning forecast email is back! It's included with every level of support — from Free to Sustainer — delivered 7 days a week. Sign up at: capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

The Friday forecast is tricky. If a cold front lingers nearby, then we could still be on the humid side with a chance of showers and storms. If the front sinks far enough to our south, then we could be drier with lower humidity. Highs should be somewhere in the 80s. Partly cloudy and less humid Friday night with lows in the 60s. Confidence: Low

High pressure looks to get the weekend off to a really nice start on Saturday, with mostly sunny skies and lower humidity as highs reach the low to mid-80s. Comfortable Saturday night as well with lows in the 60s. Confidence: Medium-High

Sunday may trend a bit warmer and more humid as high pressure starts to weaken. Highs aim for the mid- to upper 80s and a shower or storm chance could return by afternoon. Confidence: Medium

Today’s daily digit — 6/10: Humidity is somewhat tolerable, storm chances aren't too high, and highs shouldn't get much past 90 (if that). Kind of a win for mid-August! | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

DC weather history for August 12

Tropical remnants and intense storms have repeatedly drenched the region on this date—from Hurricane Connie’s record 1955 deluge to major flash flooding events in 2001 and 2014.
